pages.step_question_ko: 🧭 [핵심 발상 질문] 출발 식을 목표 결론으로 연결하기 위해 어떤 대수적 변형이나 모델을 사용하나요?
pages.step_question_en: 🧭 [Key Idea Question] What algebraic transformation or model do you use to connect the starting equation to the target conclusion?
pages.visual_focus: 단계별 수학적 추론 및 증명 전개
pages.explanation_text: 6단계, 6페이지 단계입니다. 화면에 제시된 a = c ∧ 관계를 살펴보세요. 이제 증명의 핵심 열쇠인 복소수 z = a + bi를 실수부분(a)과 허수부분(b)으로 명확히 나누고, 허수부의 부호만 바꾼 켤레복소수(a - bi)와의 합·곱이 항상 실수가 되는 대칭 구조를 활용하는 대수적 발상을 적용합니다. 이 변환을 거치면 복잡해 보이던 식의 구조가 우리가 이미 알고 있는 기본 연산으로 선명하게 풀립니다.

narrations.en: This is step 6, page 6. Look at the a = c ∧ relationship presented on the screen. Now, we clearly divide the complex number z = a + bi, which is the key to the proof, into a real part (a) and an imaginary part (b), and apply an algebraic idea that utilizes a symmetrical structure in which the sum and product of the complex conjugate number (a - bi), with only the sign of the imaginary part changed, is always a real number. After this conversion, the structure of an expression that seemed complex can be clearly solved using basic operations that we already know.

narrations.en: This is step 8, 8 pages. Take a look at the Proof relationship presented on screen. Now, we clearly divide the complex number z = a + bi, which is the key to the proof, into a real part (a) and an imaginary part (b), and apply an algebraic idea that utilizes a symmetrical structure in which the sum and product of the complex conjugate number (a - bi), with only the sign of the imaginary part changed, is always a real number. After this conversion, the structure of an expression that seemed complex can be clearly solved using basic operations that we already know.

pages.explanation_text: 9단계, 9페이지 단계입니다. 화면에 제시된 a + bi 관계를 살펴보세요. 문자와 식의 사칙연산처럼 분배법칙으로 전개한 뒤 i의 제곱 자리에 -1을 대입하여 실수부분끼리, 허수부분끼리 동류항 정리하는 원리에 따라 식이 빈틈없이 유도됩니다. 이 단계에서 특히 주의할 점은, 복소수 a+bi에서 허수부분은 bi가 아니라 i 앞에 곱해진 실수 b입니다! 또한 허수는 수직선 위에 나타낼 수 없으므로 대소 관계(크고 작음)를 비교할 수 없다는 점을 꼭 기억하세요.

narrations.en: Step 9, page 9. Look at the a + bi relationship presented on the screen. Like the four arithmetic operations of letters and expressions, it is developed using the distributive law, and then -1 is substituted in the square place of i, and the equation is derived without any gaps according to the principle of arranging like terms between the real and imaginary parts. What to pay special attention to at this step is that in the complex number a+bi, the imaginary part is not bi, but the real number b multiplied in front of i! Also, keep in mind that imaginary numbers cannot be plotted on a number line, so their size relationship (big vs. small) cannot be compared.

pages.explanation_text: 13단계, 13페이지 단계입니다. 화면에 제시된 (a −c)2 + (d −b)2 관계를 살펴보세요. 앞 단계에서 정리한 수식들을 하나로 묶어 주면, 마침내 우리가 목표로 했던 복소수의 실수부분과 허수부분을 분리하고 i의 제곱 = -1 정의를 적용하면 '복소수의 상등' 성질과 연산 법칙이 항상 성립한다는 결론이 자연스럽게 도출됩니다!

narrations.en: Step 13, page 13. Look at the (a −c)2 + (d −b)2 relationship shown on the screen. If we combine the formulas organized in the previous step into one, finally separating the real and imaginary parts of the complex number we were aiming for and applying the definition of i squared = -1, we naturally come to the conclusion that the 'equality of complex numbers' property and operation law always hold true!

narrations.en: The last 16 steps, the proof is complete! Starting from the starting condition of the 'equality of complex numbers' of the imaginary unit i (i's square = -1), which was a new number that becomes -1 when squared, and the complex number a+bi made up of the real numbers a and b, the complex number z = a + bi is clearly divided into the real part (a) and the imaginary part (b), and the algebraic idea of utilizing a symmetrical structure in which the sum and product of the conjugate complex number (a - bi), with only the sign of the imaginary part changed, is always a real number. Afterwards, it was clearly confirmed that by separating the real and imaginary parts of a complex number and applying the definition of i squared = -1, the conclusion that the 'equality of complex numbers' property and operation law always holds true. The key point to remember here is that in the complex number a+bi, the imaginary part is not bi, but the real number b multiplied in front of i! Also, keep in mind that imaginary numbers cannot be plotted on a number line, so their size relationship (big vs. small) cannot be compared. Finally, ask a deeper question. If the complex number a+bi is represented as a point (a, b) on a coordinate plane (complex plane) where the horizontal axis is the real axis and the vertical axis is the imaginary axis, how many degrees of geometric rotation will the operation of multiplying by i be? Experiment by changing the values ​​and shapes directly on the math homepage in the link in the description!
